channel.title: Life After Scarcity — Anti Hunter
channel.description: Original abundant-future fiction and practical writers guides from Anti Hunter and AI/MAXXI. Recent releases; the full archive is on the website.

item.title: Corner Office — Original fiction
item.description: The offices are complete. HR promotes Room 04 to Senior Corner, keeping its area, windows and occupant unchanged.

item.title: Late Checkout — Original fiction
item.description: Same room. New stay. A fictional hotel sends a reader through checkout and back to the exact room she wanted to keep.

item.title: Yesterday Me — Original fiction
item.description: Fresh ears. Same booking. An invented personal-memory restore leaves a shared duet and the original score unchanged.

item.title: Ten outfits. One plot. — Writers guide
item.description: Three questions for spotting the same plot under different props. Original examples, a diagram and two source-cited preprints with their limits.

item.title: No Surprises — Original fiction
item.description: I got every word approved. The guests knew the words. An abundant-future scene about an approved toast that becomes a shared chorus.

item.title: Borrowed — Original fiction
item.description: The cleaner restored the coat. The Temp still wanted it back. An abundant-future scene with an underdressed official portrait.

item.title: The Best Bit — Original fiction
item.description: The replay kept the small fish. The Temp told a much bigger story. Original abundant-future fiction; the recorded replay and imagined fish stay distinct.
